name: Woodland Lyricist Prestige Class
body:
Singers of the wilderness, sages and enchanters of animals, woodland lyricists understand the music of the natural world. They guide and protect adventurers, defend natural places from abuse and befriend special animal companions, using both bardic and divine magic to accomplish their purposes. Bard or skalds who take some interest in the druid’s way are the most likely woodland lyricists.

Requirements

To qualify to become a woodland lyricist, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Skills Diplomacy 4 ranks, Knowledge (nature) 4 ranks, Linguistics 4 ranks, Perform (song, string, or wind) 5 ranks
Spells: Ability to cast 1st-level arcane spells and 1st-level divine spells.
Special Bardic performance and wild empathy class abilities.

Class Skills The woodland lyricist’s class skills (and the key ability for each skill) are Diplomacy (Cha), Handle Animal (Cha), Knowledge (nature) (Int), Linguistics (Int), Perform (Cha), Profession (Wis), and Survival (Wis).

Hit die d8

Skill Ranks: 6 + Int

Table: Woodland Lyricist
Level	BAB	Fort	Ref	Will	Special	Spells per Day/Spells Known
1st	+0	+0	+2	+2	Bardic knowledge, wilderness cantor	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class/+1 level of existing divine spellcasting class
2nd	+1	+0	+3	+3	Improved empathic link	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class/+1 level of existing divine spellcasting class
3rd	+2	+1	+3	+3	—	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class/+1 level of existing divine spellcasting class
4th	+3	+1	+4	+4	—	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class/+1 level of existing divine spellcasting class
5th	+3	+1	+4	+4	Soothe the savage beast	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class/+1 level of existing divine spellcasting class
6th	+4	+2	+5	+5	—	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class/+1 level of existing divine spellcasting class
7th	+5	+2	+5	+5	—	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class/+1 level of existing divine spellcasting class
8th	+6	+2	+6	+6	Channel animal	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class/+1 level of existing divine spellcasting class
9th	+6	+3	+6	+6	—	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class/+1 level of existing divine spellcasting class
10th	+7	+3	+7	+7	Natural harmony	+1 level of existing arcane spellcasting class/+1 level of existing divine spellcasting class
Class Features

All of the following are class features of the woodland lyricist prestige class.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

Woodland lyricists gain no proficiency with any weapon or armor.

Spells per Day/Spells Known

At each level, a woodland lyricist gains new spells per day as if she had also gained a level in any one arcane spellcasting class and any one divine spellcasting class to which she belonged before adding the prestige class level. She does not, however, gain any other benefit a character of that class would have gained, except for additional spells per day, spells known (if she is a spontaneous caster), and an increased effective level of spellcasting. If she had more than one arcane spellcasting class or divine spellcasting class before becoming a woodland lyricist, she must decide to which class to add each woodland lyricist level for the purpose of determining spells per day, spells known, and overall caster level.

Bardic Knowledge (Ex)

At 1st level, a woodland lyricist adds half her class level to all Knowledge skill checks and may make such checks untrained. The bonuses gained from this ability stack with those gained from bardic knowledge checks.

Wilderness Cantor

A woodland lyricist’s class levels stack with her levels in any other classes for determining her animal companion, bardic performance (or raging song), and wild empathy class features. A woodland lyricist’s animal companion has an Intelligence score equal to that of a familiar belonging to a wizard of the woodland lyricist’s equivalent druid level.

Improved Empathic Link (Su)

At 2nd level, a woodland lyricist gains an empathic link with her animal companion.

This functions like an empathic link with a familiar, except the woodland lyricist can also see through a companion’s eyes as a swift action, maintaining this connection as long as she likes (as long as the companion is within 1 mile) and ending it as a free action. The woodland lyricist is blinded while maintaining this connection. If the woodland lyricist already possesses improved empathic link from another class, she instead adds her levels in woodland lyricist to her levels in that class for determining when she gains improved empathic link and greater empathic link.

Soothe the Savage Beast (Ex)

At 5th level, creatures of the animal, fey, magical beast, and plant type are affected by the woodland lyricist’s bardic performances/raging songs and by her charm or compulsion spells as if they were humanoids.

Channel Animal (Sp)

At 8th level, while using her barding performance/raging song, the woodland lyricist can expend two performance rounds to establish a magical conduit between herself and a single animal that she touches (including her animal companion). For each use of this class feature, a spell she casts whose range is touch or greater can originate from the animal instead of from the woodland lyricist, provided that she can see the animal and it would be in the spell’s range from her. She can also use this power to deliver touch spells through the animal.

Natural Harmony (Sp)

At 10th level, the woodland lyricist gains the hunter’s raise animal companion ability, using her woodland lyricist level as her equivalent hunter level; levels in this prestige class stack with hunter level for determining the ability’s effect. In addition, her channel animal ability functions now also on creatures of the plant type.
